name: coders-talk
description: Send a Codex session to Coders Talk as a draft Build: the prompts, interventions and fails that mattered. You review and publish it on the site.

interface.shortDescription: Send this session to Coders Talk as a draft
interface.longDescription: Turns the current Codex session into a draft Build on coders.talk: the prompts, the moments you stepped in and the fails that mattered. Secrets are redacted on the server. The draft is private to you, or to your team for sessions in its repositories, and nothing is published until you do it on the site.
